answer: Because the lagoon stake is held until the walnut settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the crystal audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 30% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a cheap one. A farm running 149 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation cheap. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
